patch_list: Choose a classic / premium launcher icon, or pick a PNG from your phone.
Soft-bypasses client gates that block local chat backup when Google Drive / Play Services appear missing. Prefer offline Databases folder.
Sets android:allowBackup=true so the package can participate in device backup agents (Seedvault / adb). Does not implement Drive.
Show messages that were deleted for everyone. Client-side only; already-wiped history cannot be restored.
Treats Google Play Services checks as successful so WhatsApp works better with microG. Does not replace microG itself.
Reserves a MightyMich row in Settings. Full dialog wiring needs the settings-list fingerprint for this WhatsApp build.
Adds English strings for the MightyMich section in WhatsApp Settings.
If enabled, you won't send read receipts (blue ticks).
Hides Meta AI on the chats home screen (FAB / pill), related hub entry points, and common feature gates. Does not delete existing Meta AI chats.
If enabled, others won't see when you are typing.
Limit diagnostic and analytics data WhatsApp sends.
Allow reopening and saving view once photos and videos.

sources.label: WhatsApp
sources.author: WhatsApp
patch_list: Spoof APK-integrity, root, Xposed, and Play Integrity checks so WhatsApp reports a clean, unmodified install to its own telemetry and to its server.

Prevent others from deleting their messages or statuses. Companion to Keep Deleted Messages — that patch keeps text visible locally; this one stops the revoke ACK so the server cannot confirm delivery of the deletion.
Show messages that were deleted for everyone. Client-side only; already-wiped history cannot be restored.
Experimental login compatibility patch for a re-signed APK. Requires compatible microG-RE components. Enable only if registration/login fails.

Declares android.permission.FAKE_PACKAGE_SIGNATURE so microG-RE recognizes this app and serves it a spoofed Play Store signature. Required for Login Fix Expertenmodus's signature/cert patches to have any effect.
Hides Meta AI on the chats home screen (FAB / pill), related hub entry points, and common feature gates. Does not delete existing Meta AI chats.
Limit diagnostic and analytics data WhatsApp sends.
Allow reopening and saving view once photos and videos.
